Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972 'Specification for 
stainless steel bars and flats ', 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The driver shall be free from rough edges, pits, burrs, cracks and blemishes of any kind. 



Adopted 12 November 1973 



@ January 1974, ISI

18:7055-1973 

4.2 The knurling and serrations, wherever provided, shall be well formed and clean. 

4.3 The driver shall be passivated and polished bright to give a mirror or satin finish. 

5. Heat Treatment — The driver shall be hardened and tempered to 420 to 460 HV, 

6. Tests ^ • 

6.1 Performance Tesi— Drive a 25 mm long flat head wire nail into a piece of hard wood about 
25 mm thick. Put the nail driver on the flat head of the nail and strike It 5 times with a hammer. 
The nail driver shall not bend or show any sign of damage. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance Test — Scrub the sample with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water 
and then dip in 95-percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the sample. Immerse in copper sulphate solution at 
room temperature for 6 minutes and wash with fresh water or wet cotton wool. Make up the 
solution as follows: 



Copper sulphate ( CuSO^.SHaO ) 

Sulphuric add ( H2SO4 ) ( sp gr V84 ) 

Distilled water [see IS : 1070-1960 Specification for 
water, distilled quality (revised)] 



4-0 g 
10-0 g 
90-0 ml 



There shall be no red stains or spots on t.ie sample but dulling of the polished surface may be 
permitted. 

7. Marking — Each driver shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized 
trade-mark. 

7.1/5/ Certrflc&tton Marking — DeiaWs available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
